src/api/client.js#patchItemV2: RET-02 (0.5.0 requirements §7): route PATCH /v2/items/{item_id} is live server-side but has no frontend caller yet. AST-04 (requirements-0.5.0.md §1.2) needs a PATCH to rename an asset's alias without changing its ID; that UI lands in Step 3 (the asset model). Delete or wire when Step 3 builds the rename control.
src/api/client.js#createIssueAnalysesV2: RET-02 (0.5.0 requirements §7): POST /v2/issues/{issue_row_id}/analysis is a fully-implemented backend capability (ai/v2/issues.py's sandboxed additional-analysis execution) with no frontend caller yet. Wiring it into IssueRca.jsx is a UI feature addition, out of RET's scope (Step 1 forbids changing a live component's rendering).
src/api/client.js#interpretIssueAnalyses: RET-02 (0.5.0 requirements §7): pairs with createIssueAnalysesV2 (POST /v2/issues/{issue_row_id}/analysis/interpret) — same live backend capability, same reason.
src/api/client.js#getFrameworkTestsV2: RET-02 (0.5.0 requirements §7): route GET /v2/framework/tests is live. DQFramework.jsx already renders overview/areas/matrix (getFrameworkOverviewV2/getFrameworkAreasV2/getFrameworkMatrixV2) but has no per-test drill-down view yet; this is the fetcher for that view when it is built.
src/api/client.js#getResultTagsV3: RET-02 (0.5.0 requirements §7): route GET /v3/results/{result_id}/tags is live. TagPicker.jsx already handles item- and issue-level tags (getItemTagsV3/getIssueTagsV3); this is the fetcher for a result-level tagging UI, not yet built.
src/api/client.js#getTestTagsV3: RET-02 (0.5.0 requirements §7): route GET /v3/tests/{row_id}/tags is live, same reason as getResultTagsV3 — a test-level tagging UI is not yet built.
src/api/client.js#dispositionFindingV2: Compatibility keep: POST /v2/diagnostics/findings/{finding_id}/disposition remains a live backend and client API. The current Test Lab rebuild keeps its findings decision pane dormant, so removing this export would break the established client contract before that pane is re-enabled.
src/api/client.js#getAnalysisArtifactV2: Compatibility keep: GET /v2/analysis-artifacts/{artifact_id} remains a live metadata-detail endpoint. The repository currently obtains equivalent bounded metadata from list responses, but this named client API must remain available to existing callers.
src/api/client.js#getAnalysisArtifactTyp: Compatibility keep: GET /v2/analysis-artifacts/types remains a live discovery endpoint. The current repository does not render a type-filter control, but preserving public APIs requires retaining its named client function.
